chunks: May Allāh reward such and such man

who straightened the curve, cured the disease, abandoned mischief and established the sunnah. He departed (from this world) with untarnished clothes and little shortcomings. He achieved good (of this world) and remained safe from its evils. He offered Allāh’s obedience and feared Him as He deserved. He went away and left the people in dividing ways wherein the misled cannot obtain guidance and the guided cannot attain certainty.
and the guided cannot attain certainty.

key_terms.نَقِيَّ الثَّوْب: pure in garment (metaphor for purity of character)

ai.seo_question: Who is the companion praised in Nahj al-Balagha for establishing the Sunnah and curing the disease of the community?
ai.summary: This passage from Nahj al-Balagha is widely interpreted by Shia scholars as a eulogy for either Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib or a prominent companion like Abu Bakr, highlighting his role in stabilizing the early community by establishing the Sunnah and mitigating fitnah. The text emphasizes his spiritual purity and successful navigation of worldly affairs, noting that his departure left the Ummah in a state of divergent paths where neither the misguided nor the guided could find absolute certainty.
